## Selected case studies

Custom Ticketing & POS Operations System
Problem: The legacy Perl and PHP process did not give tickets, labor, pricing, parts, and computer-build details one maintainable operational record.
Environment: Internal business operations, existing POS workflow, Microsoft SQL Server
Actions: Designed and built a custom Python and JavaScript application from the ground up without adapting a commercial or open-source ticketing base.
Result: Fully replaced and retired the legacy Perl/PHP ticketing workflow with one maintainable system built around the business's actual operations.
Technologies: Python, JavaScript, Microsoft SQL Server, POS Integration

VSS Live-Imaging Workflow
Problem: The existing imaging process slowed endpoint deployment and could carry operating-system corruption into the replacement system.
Environment: Windows endpoint deployment, live systems, Volume Shadow Copy Service
Actions: Developed an in-house VSS live-imaging and delta-merging workflow that restored programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation.
Result: Improved deployment stability by avoiding corruption carried forward from the previous Windows installation.
Evidence: Reduced endpoint deployment time by an average of 40% and improved stability by restoring programs and data onto a fresh Windows installation instead of carrying forward OS corruption.
Technologies: VSS, Windows Deployment, Endpoint Imaging

NewComputerSetup
Problem: New-computer setup required repetitive manual configuration in client environments where PXE was not always available.
Environment: Windows workstations, MSP client standards, non-PXE deployment environments
Actions: Built a customizable Batch workflow that applied the required software, settings, naming, upgrade, and handoff steps consistently.
Result: Made workstation deployment faster and more consistent across MSP clients.
Evidence: Reduced manual workstation setup time by 75% through Batch deployment automation.
Technologies: Batch, Windows Deployment, Endpoint Administration
Repository: https://github.com/Jessomadic/NewComputerSetup/tree/Main

Active Directory Reporting Tool
Problem: Large Active Directory group-information requests required repetitive manual lookup and formatting.
Environment: Enterprise Active Directory, PowerShell, Windows Forms, healthcare help desk operations
Actions: Built a simple interface that recursively queried Active Directory group membership and exported name, email, and SAM account name to CSV.
Result: Made large Active Directory exports repeatable and fast.
Evidence: Reduced requests covering hundreds or thousands of Active Directory users from hours or days of manual work to a CSV generated in seconds.
Technologies: PowerShell, Active Directory, Windows Forms, CSV
Repository: https://github.com/Jessomadic/AD-Export-Tool
